prompts.membrane: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one highly detailed photorealistic 3D production reference of an environmental secret structure for BIOSO. Single isolated complete object, neutral charcoal background, no surrounding landscape, no ground plinth, no text, no UI, no human or robot. Orthographic three-quarter view from the south, elevated 52 degrees above ground, entire object with 10% margin. Smooth natural silhouettes and realistic fabrication, layered construction with strong readable large forms plus fine texture. This is a functional small building approximately 3 metres wide, not a handheld prop or low-poly toy. Subject: an abandoned overgrown circular bio-vault access hatch, a substantial squat structure with a tilted vertical oval pressure door, thick dark industrial frame and chipped ivory segmented ceramic outer casing. The door opening is completely sealed by a taut olive gray organic membrane with branching veins and root tendrils, unmistakably dissolvable biological obstruction. Dark recessed machinery behind the opaque membrane, no glass window. Bolted rim, locking clamps, pipes, side service housings, one tiny dim mint status light, sparse moss in crevices. Asymmetrical believable wear. Style reference: attached biomecha-style-master.png is authoritative for materials, palette, light and mood. Cinematic photorealistic grounded solarpunk, physically plausible weathered materials and natural proportions. Desaturated olive foliage, gray fractured stone, dirty warm-white ceramic panels, dark aged industrial metal, restrained rust. Low warm sunlight from upper left with cool ambient fill and deep detailed shadows. Quiet reclaimed industrial world, realistic microtexture without exaggerated contrast. No cartoon, no painterly brush strokes, no storybook illustration, no toy diorama, no ornate golden domes, no saturated yellow-green foliage, no glossy plastic, no heavy sepia wash. Do not copy the robot or portrait composition.
